email.body:
NOON REPORT - MV KESTREL MOOR
Date/time: 26 Jan 2025 0400 UTC (ship's time UTC+8: 26 Jan 1200)
Position: 32-31.0N 122-10.7E
Distance run last 24h: 272.8 nm
Average speed last 24h: 12.4 kn
ROB VLSFO: 1041.9 t
ROB MGO: 77.8 t
Consumption last 24h: VLSFO 37.6 t, MGO 0.2 t
Next port: Qingdao
ETA Qingdao: 2025-01-27 0300 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Main engine stopped 0100-0300 UTC: vessel drifted off the Qingdao approaches awaiting the pilot boarding time given by the agent. No defect, no repair involved. Average speed given over steaming time.

Master MV KESTREL MOOR
